C1697.title: Two Trillion Files Exposed Globally Due to Cloud Storage Bucket Misconfigurations
C1697.summary: In March 2026, researchers discovered that misconfigured storage buckets across multiple major cloud providers left approximately two trillion files publicly accessible. The exposure involved 660,000 unprotected buckets on seven major cloud platforms, leaking confidential documents, login credentials, and source code.
